headline: UK Treasury Estimates Potential £1 Trillion Sovereign Fund from North Sea Oil
summary: The UK Treasury calculated for the first time that Britain could have accumulated a sovereign wealth fund worth one trillion pounds if historic North Sea oil revenues had been invested.
why: Long-term sovereign resource management remains a central debate in UK fiscal policy and energy taxation as North Sea basin production winds down.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Treasury retrospectives inform domestic debates over public wealth creation and resource taxation strategies.
